payload.text: Atinary | Turbocharge your R&D with SDLabs Skip to content Exponential science Pioneers of Self-Driving Labs®. Augmenting humans with AI and Robotics to accelerate scientific discovery Watch The Demo See How It Works Contact Us Augmenting humans with AI and Robotics to accelerate Science AI platform SDLabs Atinary’s AI-driven R&D platform integrates machine learning (ML) optimizers, data analytics, and visualization into a single intuitive interface, enabling scientists to solve complex, multi-objective optimization challenges faster when designing and running experiments. Meet SDLabs Self-Driving Labs® Atinary recently launched its own Self-Driving Lab, a smart data and IP factory in Boston, Massachusetts. With Self-Driving Labs® reimagine the physical laboratory by integrating AI, robotics, and human expertise into a unified, closed-loop ecosystem for faster innovation. Look into our Self-Driving Labs Learn more about our Technology Our mission is to build intelligent solutions for a healthier and more sustainable future. By integrating AI and robotics with human expertise – our Self-Driving Labs® – we accelerate the development of molecules and materials among millions of possibilities. We are reimagining the laboratory to dissolve traditional bottlenecks and unlock limitless science, enabling researchers to focus their expertise where it matters most: pure innovation. Our technologies transform science and drive innovation in life-, chemical-, and materials sciences. Why Atinary? The Leading Self-Driving Labs® Platform Thoughts Leaders and Pioneers of Self-Driving Labs® Higher efficiency and productivity strengthens pipeline and competitiveness Deploys Agentic Platform in Under Two Hours Seamless Integration with Robotic Platforms (optional) Proven and Validated by Industry and Academia Thoughts Leaders and Pioneers of Self-Driving Labs® Founders coined the term Self-Driving Labs® and have been thought leaders in AI-driven R&D since 2017. Top multi-disciplinary team, including world-leading experts on its Scientific Advisory Board such as MIT Prof. Steve Buchwald (most cited chemist in the world between 1999 – 2009). Global partnerships and strong collaborations with leading companies, including ABB robotics , Agilent , AWS , Chemspeed , and Mettler Toledo , among others. Deploys Agentic Platform in Under Two Hours Superior UI and UX, code-free agentic platform does not require any experience or knowledge in coding, machine learning, or data science to use. Integrates into your existing workflows and get running… [/about] About Us – Atinary About Us About Us – Atinary Skip to content About Us Learn more about our Story, Vision, Mission, and Team Our Story As pioneers of Self-Driving Labs®, Atinary’s founders, Dr. Hermann Tribukait and Dr. Loïc Roch, coined the term in 2017 following their leadership of a global innovation initiative on accelerating materials discovery for leading scientists. This collaboration produced the foundational roadmap that pioneered the “closed-loop” integration of AI and robotics into autonomous systems that think and learn independently. Our Vision Our vision is to unlock limitless science and accelerate the transition to a healthier, more sustainable future. We are reimagining the laboratory to dissolve traditional bottlenecks, enabling scientists to focus their expertise where it matters most: pure innovation. Our Mission Our mission is to build intelligent solutions for science that integrate AI and robotics with human expertise – we call it Self-Driving Labs® – in order to accelerate the development of molecules and materials among millions of possibilities. Did you know Behind the Name The name Atinary comes from the Spanish verb atinar , which means hit , as in hit the target. Our leading ML technology can hit targets ten to a thousand times faster than standard methods used in industry and academia, such as Design of Experiments (DoE) and High-throughput Experimentation (HTE). In addition, our ML algorithms outperform competing ML algorithms. Meet our Team With 13 nationalities represented, our multidisciplinary team of innovators includes software engineers, developers, data scientists, AI and machine learning experts, chemists, biochemists, and business leaders. Our Founders Our founders have worked together since 2017 developing the Self-Driving Labs ® technology.
